replicate_statements: Mean±s.d. of three independent experiments is reported.
outputs.explanation: The caption explicitly states that the cell death quantification is the mean±s.d. of three independent experiments, giving both the number (n=3) and type (independent experiments) of replicates. The accompanying western blots are representative single images and are not separately quantified.

The bar graph shows quantified cell death percentages with variability (error bar marks) across conditions, implying repeated measurements, but the caption for panel B gives no statement of how many experiments were performed or what kind of replicate (independent experiment, technical replicate, etc.) underlies the data.
